'''''Sonchus bulbosus''''', the '''tuberous hawk's-beard''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is a [[tuber]]ous [[geophyte]] native to the [[Mediterranean basin]] countries of southern Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, as well as the [[Azores]] ([[Terceira]]) and [[Ireland]].<ref name=powo/>

Three subspecies are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Sonchus bulbosus'' subsp. ''bulbosus'' (synonyms ''Hieracium stoloniferum'' {{small|Viv.}} and ''H. tuberosum'' {{small|Brot.}}) – Mediterranean basin, Azores (Terceira), and Ireland
*''Sonchus bulbosus'' subsp. ''microcephalus'' {{small|(Rech.f.) N.Kilian & Greuter}} – Greece, Turkey, Cyprus, Lebanon, and Syria
*''Sonchus bulbosus'' subsp. ''willkomii'' {{small|(Burnat & Barbey) N.Kilian & Greuter}} – [[Balearic Islands]]
